mapper.select: SELECT c.tenant_id AS tenantId, u.user_id AS userId, u.user_name AS userName, u.nick_name AS nickName, u.phonenumber, c.coach_id AS coachId, c.store_id AS storeId, st.store_name AS storeName, c.coach_name AS coachName, c.mobile, c.avatar_url AS avatarUrl, c.skill_tags AS skillTags, c.level_code AS levelCode, c.intro, c.hire_status AS hireStatus, u.status AS userStatus, u.password FROM fit_coach c INNER JOIN sys_user u ON u.user_id = c.user_id AND u.tenant_id = c.tenant_id AND u.del_flag = '0' LEFT JOIN fit_store st ON st.store_id = c.store_id AND st.del_flag = '0' WHERE c.del_flag = '0' AND c.tenant_id = '000000' AND u.user_name = #{username} LIMIT 1

SELECT c.tenant_id AS tenantId, u.user_id AS userId, u.user_name AS userName, u.nick_name AS nickName, u.phonenumber, c.coach_id AS coachId, c.store_id AS storeId, st.store_name AS storeName, c.coach_name AS coachName, c.mobile, c.avatar_url AS avatarUrl, c.skill_tags AS skillTags, c.level_code AS levelCode, c.intro, c.hire_status AS hireStatus, u.status AS userStatus, u.password FROM fit_coach c INNER JOIN sys_user u ON u.user_id = c.user_id AND u.tenant_id = c.tenant_id AND u.del_flag = '0' LEFT JOIN fit_store st ON st.store_id = c.store_id AND st.del_flag = '0' WHERE c.del_flag = '0' AND c.coach_id = #{coachId} LIMIT 1

SELECT c.tenant_id AS tenantId, u.user_id AS userId, u.user_name AS userName, u.nick_name AS nickName, u.phonenumber, c.coach_id AS coachId, c.store_id AS storeId, st.store_name AS storeName, c.coach_name AS coachName, c.mobile, c.avatar_url AS avatarUrl, c.skill_tags AS skillTags, c.level_code AS levelCode, c.intro, c.hire_status AS hireStatus, u.status AS userStatus, u.password FROM fit_coach c INNER JOIN sys_user u ON u.user_id = c.user_id AND u.tenant_id = c.tenant_id AND u.del_flag = '0' LEFT JOIN fit_store st ON st.store_id = c.store_id AND st.del_flag = '0' WHERE c.del_flag = '0' AND u.user_id = #{userId} LIMIT 1

SELECT IFNULL(( SELECT COUNT(1) FROM fit_course_schedule s WHERE s.del_flag = '0' AND s.coach_id = #{coachId} AND s.schedule_date = CURDATE() ), 0) AS todayScheduleCount, IFNULL(( SELECT COUNT(1) FROM fit_checkin_record cr INNER JOIN fit_course_schedule s ON s.schedule_id = cr.schedule_id AND s.del_flag = '0' WHERE cr.del_flag = '0' AND s.coach_id = #{coachId} AND cr.checkin_status = 'success' AND cr.operator_user_id IS NULL ), 0) AS pendingCheckinCount, IFNULL(( SELECT COUNT(1) FROM fit_checkin_record cr INNER JOIN fit_course_schedule s ON s.schedule_id = cr.schedule_id AND s.del_flag = '0' WHERE cr.del_flag = '0' AND s.coach_id = #{coachId} AND cr.checkin_status = 'success' AND cr.operator_user_id IS NOT NULL ), 0) AS confirmedCount, IFNULL(( SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT mc.member_id) FROM fit_member_card mc WHERE mc.del_flag = '0' AND mc.bind_coach_id = #{coachId} ), 0) AS totalStudentCount, IFNULL(( SELECT COUNT(1) FROM fit_course_schedule s WHERE s.del_flag = '0' AND s.coach_id = #{coachId} AND YEARWEEK(s.schedule_date, 1) = YEARWEEK(CURDATE(), 1) ), 0) AS weekSessionCount

SELECT s.schedule_id AS scheduleId, s.store_id AS storeId, st.store_name AS storeName, s.course_id AS courseId, c.course_name AS courseName, c.course_type AS courseType, s.coach_id AS coachId, coach.coach_name AS coachName, s.schedule_date AS scheduleDate, s.start_time AS startTime, s.end_time AS endTime, s.capacity, s.reserved_count AS reservedCount, s.signed_count AS signedCount, s.schedule_status AS scheduleStatus FROM fit_course_schedule s INNER JOIN fit_course c ON c.course_id = s.course_id AND c.del_flag = '0' LEFT JOIN fit_store st ON st.store_id = s.store_id AND st.del_flag = '0' LEFT JOIN fit_coach coach ON coach.coach_id = s.coach_id AND coach.del_flag = '0' WHERE s.del_flag = '0' AND s.coach_id = #{coachId} AND s.schedule_id = #{scheduleId} LIMIT 1

AND (cr.checkin_id IS NULL OR (cr.checkin_status = 'success' AND cr.operator_user_id IS NULL))
AND cr.checkin_status = 'success' AND cr.operator_user_id IS NOT NULL
AND cr.checkin_status = 'reversed'
ORDER BY cr.checkin_time DESC, cr.checkin_id DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE fit_checkin_record SET operator_user_id = #{operatorUserId}, consume_times = #{consumeTimes}, consume_amount = #{consumeAmount}, checkin_status = 'success', remark = CASE WHEN #{remark} IS NOT NULL THEN #{remark} ELSE remark END, update_time = NOW() WHERE checkin_id = #{checkinId} AND del_flag = '0' AND operator_user_id IS NULL

UPDATE fit_checkin_record SET operator_user_id = #{operatorUserId}, checkin_status = 'reversed', remark = CASE WHEN #{remark} IS NOT NULL THEN #{remark} ELSE remark END, update_time = NOW() WHERE checkin_id = #{checkinId} AND del_flag = '0' AND checkin_status != 'reversed'
UPDATE fit_course_schedule SET signed_count = CASE WHEN signed_count + #{delta} < 0 THEN 0 ELSE signed_count + #{delta} END, update_time = NOW() WHERE schedule_id = #{scheduleId} AND del_flag = '0'

UPDATE fit_member_card SET used_times = CASE WHEN #{consumeTimes} IS NULL THEN used_times ELSE used_times + #{consumeTimes} END, remain_times = CASE WHEN #{consumeTimes} IS NULL THEN remain_times WHEN remain_times - #{consumeTimes} < 0 THEN 0 ELSE remain_times - #{consumeTimes} END, balance_amount = CASE WHEN #{consumeAmount} IS NULL THEN balance_amount WHEN balance_amount - #{consumeAmount} < 0 THEN 0 ELSE balance_amount - #{consumeAmount} END, card_status = CASE WHEN card_status = 'unused' THEN 'active' ELSE card_status END, update_time = NOW() WHERE card_id = #{cardId} AND del_flag = '0'
mapper.select: SELECT m.member_id AS memberId, m.real_name AS realName, m.nickname, m.mobile, m.avatar_url AS avatarUrl, m.last_visit_time AS lastVisitTime, mc.card_id AS cardId, mc.card_name AS cardName, mc.remain_times AS remainTimes, mc.balance_amount AS balanceAmount, ( SELECT s2.start_time FROM fit_course_schedule s2 INNER JOIN fit_course_reservation r2 ON r2.schedule_id = s2.schedule_id AND r2.del_flag = '0' AND r2.member_id = m.member_id AND r2.reservation_status = 'reserved' WHERE s2.del_flag = '0' AND s2.coach_id = #{coachId} AND s2.start_time > NOW() ORDER BY s2.start_time ASC LIMIT 1 ) AS nextClassTime, ( SELECT c2.course_name FROM fit_course_schedule s2 INNER JOIN fit_course c2 ON c2.course_id = s2.course_id AND c2.del_flag = '0' INNER JOIN fit_course_reservation r2 ON r2.schedule_id = s2.schedule_id AND r2.del_flag = '0' AND r2.member_id = m.member_id AND r2.reservation_status = 'reserved' WHERE s2.del_flag = '0' AND s2.coach_id = #{coachId} AND s2.start_time > NOW() ORDER BY s2.start_time ASC LIMIT 1 ) AS nextCourseName, IFNULL((SELECT COUNT(1) FROM fit_checkin_record cr WHERE cr.del_flag = '0' AND cr.member_id = m.member_id AND cr.operator_user_id IS NOT NULL), 0) AS totalCheckinCount FROM fit_member_card mc INNER JOIN fit_member m ON m.member_id = mc.member_id AND m.del_flag = '0' WHERE mc.del_flag = '0' AND mc.bind_coach_id = #{coachId} AND mc.member_id = #{memberId} ORDER BY mc.create_time DESC, mc.card_id DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE fit_coach SET coach_name = CASE WHEN #{bo.coachName} IS NOT NULL AND #{bo.coachName} != '' THEN #{bo.coachName} ELSE coach_name END, mobile = CASE WHEN #{bo.mobile} IS NOT NULL AND #{bo.mobile} != '' THEN #{bo.mobile} ELSE mobile END, avatar_url = CASE WHEN #{bo.avatarUrl} IS NOT NULL AND #{bo.avatarUrl} != '' THEN #{bo.avatarUrl} ELSE avatar_url END, skill_tags = CASE WHEN #{bo.skillTags} IS NOT NULL THEN #{bo.skillTags} ELSE skill_tags END, intro = CASE WHEN #{bo.intro} IS NOT NULL THEN #{bo.intro} ELSE intro END, remark = CASE WHEN #{bo.remark} IS NOT NULL THEN #{bo.remark} ELSE remark END, update_time = NOW() WHERE coach_id = #{coachId} AND del_flag = '0'
